_comment: Additions to existing upstream technologies (merged in). New technologies live in the other files.

Linear App.description: Linear is an issue tracking and project planning tool for software teams.

Freshchat._why: Upstream only knows wchat.freshchat.com and the Freshbots global. Current installs load the widget from the account's own host (<account>.freshchat.com/js/widget.js) and expose window.fcWidget (seen on app.risevest.com, 2026-11-10).

MetaMap._why: Upstream only knows sdk.getmati.com (the old Mati brand). The current web SDK loads from web-button.metamap.com (seen on app.risevest.com, 2026-11-10).
